# RECALL

Keep project decisions and useful context in a local memory store.

| Maintenance | Maintained |
|---|---|
| Version | 1.6.3 |
| Clients | Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code (legacy) |
| License | Apache-2.0 |
| Source | [Repository](https://github.com/0langa/RECALL) |

Personally used and maintained as needed, without a release schedule or support guarantee.

## Example request

> Use RECALL to remember this project decision and the reasons behind it.

## Requirements

Python-based local plugin. Platform-specific setup is documented in the source repository; this release does not certify every operating system.

- Python 3.11 or newer
- Git
- A local project folder

## Install

### Codex

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
codex plugin add recall@0langas-plugins
```

### Claude Code

```shell
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
claude plugin install recall@0langas-plugins
```

## Setup and use

- Start a new session in your project and ask RECALL to initialize it.
- Memory stays in the project-local .recall store. The plugin supplies its MCP configuration; do not add a second manual server entry.

## Legacy Kimi compatibility

Kimi compatibility is retained but is not actively tested. First prepare a [recursive checkout](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#development-checkout). Replace the example path with your checkout.

```text
/plugins marketplace C:\path\to\plugins\kimi-marketplace.json
/plugins install C:\path\to\plugins\plugins\RECALL\plugins\recall
/reload
```
